results.title: Datasets and Benchmarks Track: Call for Papers - KDD 2026
results.content: The ACM has an authorship policy stating who can be considered an author in a submission as well as the use of generative AI tools. In the Datasets & Benchmark Track, the number of submissions allowed per author is limited to a maximum of two per cycle. * Every submission must nominate at least one author who is a qualified reviewer (i.e., authors with at least three papers in KDD or other related conferences).
